newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates plunge on funds inflow.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates plunge on funds inflow.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates plunged on an inflow of about 500 million rupees ending a week-long funds shortage, dealers said.
The overnight funds opened at 11 percent but came down to four percent due to excess liquidity in the system, a dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank said.
At the end of the day, offers were seen at the level of three percent but no borrowing interest was seen and the market closed at two percent, the dealer said.
